verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll has its own programmatic, non-UI surface: the QuickBooks Workforce API (GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks) covers employee data, deductions, payslips and pensions, and developers get a sandbox company for testing. The in-app 'auto payroll' feature is a recurring schedule inside the product, not headless or CI automation, so it is not credited. missing for 10: evidence that payroll runs can be triggered via the API, any CLI or CI/headless-runner documentation, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Build payroll tools with the QuickBooks Workforce API -- schema, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, samples, and publishing.
